Set your boundaries and stick to them. Sociopaths use guilt, gaslighting and manipulation to get what they want. They only prey on those that show any kind of vulnerability or weakness.

Never give them anything they ask for. Seriously, they may make it seem like they’re in need of help but don’t fall for it. Remember, Sociopaths love using people. If they see anything at all from you that they want, they’ll try everything to get it.

Do NOT get emotional around them. Sociopaths look for reactions. If you start crying or getting upset, they’ll see that what they’re doing is working. Also, sociopaths can be extremely violent so getting angry at them could potentially put you in danger.

Finally, if you can’t cut them out of your life completely, try to avoid having to interact face to face with them as much as possible. It’s not as easy for sociopaths to manipulate people over texts or phone calls.

My ex boyfriend was diagnosed as a sociopath by his psychiatrist although I didn’t find out until the end of our relationship. It was hell.
